purpose: Field registry for the Spatial Gene Prediction Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name only.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps distinguish histology-driven, reference-assisted, generative, uncertainty-calibrated, and foundation-model routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates image-only, ST-plus-reference, ST-plus-image, and prediction-postprocessing routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Spatial Gene Prediction.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the expression prediction, enhancement, reconstruction, imputation, or uncertainty role; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-task methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as predicted expression matrix, enhanced transcriptome, single-cell reconstruction, cell-distribution map, or uncertainty intervals.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression matrices, reconstruction outputs, distribution maps, and uncertainty layers.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, high-resolution histology, or large reference datasets.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps decide whether large slides, many genes, or atlas-scale references require extra scrutiny.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support. Use unclear when PubMed and the frozen input do not provide a verified primary link.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed from PubMed text or the frozen Layer 1 input.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or community-use evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, and risk fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Prediction Route
fields.definition: Primary route by which the method supports spatial gene prediction.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the dominant route.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates the main branches in this topic before method-level tie-breaks.

fields.name: Input Dependence
fields.definition: Dominant required external signal beyond the spatial expression object.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use none when the method operates mainly on existing predictions or measured ST without requiring a new external reference.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents choosing a method whose required image, reference, or prediction input is absent.

fields.name: Reference Dependence
fields.definition: Whether the method depends on external single-cell references, paired ST training data, pretrained priors, or existing predictions.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the dominant dependence. This is a selection cue, not an execution claim.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights reference mismatch, training-domain shift, and model-prior bias risks.

fields.name: Resolution Target
fields.definition: Coarse spatial or molecular resolution target of the prediction output.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the main claimed output resolution.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates spot-level histology prediction, whole-transcriptome enhancement, single-cell reconstruction, and uncertainty outputs.

fields.name: Uncertainty Handling
fields.definition: Whether uncertainty calibration is an explicit method contribution.
fields.fill_rule: Use explicit when the method directly provides calibrated uncertainty; otherwise use not primary or unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Identifies when prediction uncertainty should be carried into downstream decisions.

fields.name: Prediction-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about domain shift, reference mismatch, hallucinated expression, resolution inflation, annotation coupling, or other prediction-specific risk.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score unless later evidence justifies that.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit in method selection.
